text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] us-east ingress spike: intermittent 502s and elevated p99 starting 12:05 UTC. Impact ~1-4% of hosted requests. Mitigation: steering traffic away from suspect hosts. Monitor: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2340001111

nina.ops: noticed influx of 502s on ingress-proxy-7, queue depth climbing.

cole.eng: looking at recent rollout, ingress-service:v2.2.1 introduced prewarm-heavy init path. seeing OOMKilled on init container under burst.

nina.ops: cordoned node-pool-d and draining affected hosts at 12:09 UTC.

mira.support: preparing customer blurb: "Intermittent 502s observed in US-EAST for a small subset of requests. We are mitigating and will update shortly."

cole.eng: disabling prewarm flag and triggering rollback to v2.1.10 (prewarm off) at 12:12 UTC.

nina.ops: rollback applied, traffic shifted; error rate dropping to ~0.5% at 12:22 UTC. warming caches and inflight requests draining.

raj.pm: ETA for clear? Need to update execs.

cole.eng: estimating full recovery in 10-20m assuming no further restarts. will confirm when stable <0.3% for 5m.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Error rate returned to baseline (~0.2%) at 12:35 UTC. Mitigation summary: rolled back to v2.1.10, drained affected nodes, disabled prewarm init. No customer data loss. Postmortem scheduled 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC in #incidents-postmortems. Runbook: https://status.redwood.ai/runbooks/ingress-init-rollback

mira.support: customer note posted and shared in #customer-updates.

raj.pm: thanks team — please capture timeline & RCA in postmortem doc. Owners: nina.ops (ops timeline), cole.eng (root cause & fix), mira.support (customer comms).
